intro: A Glyph of Azora is an arcane tracking device crafted by the wizard Theocritus at the Tower of Azora. Bound to the scrying power of the Eye of Azora, these inscribed stones allow the mage to peer across distances and delve into the thoughts of his enemies.

p: From his tower in Elwynn Forest, the wizard Theocritus works tirelessly to monitor hostile powers threatening the realm. While his crystal relic, the Eye of Azora, enables long-range visual scrying, it lacks the reach to pierce deeper into the minds and plans of adversaries. To overcome this limitation, Theocritus embeds miniature focuses known as Glyphs of Azora. Once affixed to a surface in a remote location, a glyph acts as an anchor for his magic, allowing him not only to read enemy intentions but also to project his voice across miles to communicate directly with field agents.
